description: Windows PC cleaner for temporary files, caches, large files, duplicates, and startup entries.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Cleanly application payload archive was not found.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Cleanly.exe was not found after extracting the NSIS payload.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appAsar -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'resources\app.asar was not found after extracting the NSIS payload.' }
notes: Uses the application payload extracted from the official NSIS setup. The installer itself is not executed; Scoop extracts its nested app-64.7z payload into the app directory.
The Electron Builder portable target is not used because it extracts the application into the Windows temporary directory when launched.
Settings and encrypted API keys are stored in Electron's per-user userData directory under %APPDATA%, outside the Scoop app folder. They remain there when the Scoop app is uninstalled.
The upstream safety model permanently deletes selected caches, temporary files, and logs. Review the selected cleanup categories carefully before running cleanup.
